findings.heading: Decode the Python model catalog at the wire boundary
findings.finding: The browser now returns generated App configuration messages directly. The Python test client still indexes decoded dictionaries for the model catalog, then validates the internal catalog.
findings.action: Review the prototype’s normalization of omitted fields and rejection errors, then keep the catalog’s domain validation when moving to generated decoding.
findings.probe: A disposable generated-decoder implementation passed the App client target, including four new vectors. Omitted repeated fields became empty lists; duplicate model IDs, an unknown harness number and dangling model offers were refused. Error types and newly accepted combinations still need review.

findings.heading: Share a minimal Egress Relay settings corpus
findings.finding: Python authors the relay settings. Go loads them and already checks malformed configurations separately. The associated process fixture passes serialized settings to the Go relay.
findings.action: Feed both test suites the same default, supported transport and malformed-path vectors. Decide whether each rejection belongs to authoring validation, runtime validation or both.

findings.heading: Pin the remaining Python ThreadView join
findings.finding: The test client composes App metadata with the History summary. It retains manual wire mapping for the harness, feed state and cursor, even after the old App thread stream was retired.
findings.action: Try generated decoding at the boundary with fixtures for a missing attachment, the historical harness, an unknown feed status and a cursor above JavaScript’s exact integer range. Keep the explicit App/History composition.

findings.heading: Narrow Haku preview assertions to Launch Routine
findings.finding: Gmail, Tana, Calendar and Grocy previews moved to Agentplane. Haku’s specialized registry no longer spans those integrations. The remaining screenshot still waits for the outer card.
findings.action: If the Haku preview can reach generic fallback, assert the specialized Launch Routine widget in the existing capture. Judge the migrated tools in Agentplane’s preview tests.
findings.probe: The source screen found one specialized registry entry.

findings.heading: Derive the sample spend totals from the ledger
findings.finding: The finance fixture hand-builds two card summaries beside their transaction ledger. An independent test already checks the same accounts and statement spend.
findings.action: Derive posted and pending amounts from ledger rows, preserving fixed expected totals and the separate provisional-period case.
